name: entscheidsuche
description: Search and read Swiss court decisions and case law on entscheidsuche.ch.

interface.longDescription:
entscheidsuche.ch is the open, non-profit search engine for Swiss court decisions, run by the association entscheidsuche.ch. It covers published decisions of the Swiss Federal Supreme Court (BGer, BGE), the other federal courts, the cantonal courts and administrative authorities, in German, French and Italian.

Ask a legal question in your own words and get the matching decisions together with the relevant passage. The search works by meaning and across languages: a question in English or German also finds French and Italian decisions. You can also search for exact words and phrases, look up a case number or a BGE citation, restrict results to a canton, court or period, and read the full text of a decision.

Every result links to the decision on entscheidsuche.ch, so citations can be checked against the source. The service is free of charge and needs no account. It provides court decisions, not legislation and not legal advice.
capabilities: Search Swiss court decisions by meaning
Look up case numbers and BGE citations
Read the full text of a decision
defaultPrompt: Find Swiss court decisions on termination of a lease for the landlord's own use
Look up BGE 142 III 1 and give me the link
Which cantons have the most decisions on Eigenbedarf?

positive.description: A legal question from a visitor to Switzerland, asked in English; the decisions found are in French and German.
positive.prompt: If, as a tourist, I exceed the speed limit of 50 km/h with a rental car by more than 25 km/h or more than 40 km/h, what kind of sanction can apply to me? Is this limited to a fine that might not be enforceable abroad, can I go to jail directly in Switzerland and can the car be confiscated? Please provide references in the Swiss case law by using entscheidsuche.ch
positive.expected_behavior: The user asks in English which sanctions apply to a tourist who exceeds a 50 km/h speed limit by more than 25 km/h or by more than 40 km/h with a rental car: only a fine, imprisonment, confiscation of the car. The plugin calls search with the legal questions as query (one or several calls). Each response has search_mode "semantic" and returns Swiss decisions on speeding, each with a passage in text and a url on entscheidsuche.ch; although the question is in English, the decisions are in French or German. On 25 November 2026 the results included Tribunal cantonal Vaud CR.2005.0130 of 24 February 2006 (25 km/h over the limit in a built-up area by the holder of a foreign licence is a serious case), Cour de justice Geneva A/5147/2007 of 4 March 2008 (driving ban for Switzerland), Tribunal cantonal Neuchâtel ARMP.2019.85 of 13 August 2019 (Art. 90 paras. 3 and 4 of the Road Traffic Act: custodial sentence of one to four years for particularly serious speeding; seizure of the vehicle with a view to confiscation) and Tribunal cantonal Vaud CREP 27 mars 2013/186 (108 km/h where 50 km/h is allowed; confiscation of the motorcycle not considered indispensable). Relevant decisions are retrieved in full text with fetch (or fetch_document). The answer, in English, addresses fine, custodial sentence, driving ban and confiscation, and cites the decisions with court, date, case number and link. Where the returned decisions do not cover a point (for example the enforcement of a fine abroad or the confiscation of a car that does not belong to the driver), the answer says so. The assessment is written by ChatGPT; the plugin supplies the decisions. The exact decisions may differ because the index grows daily.

positive.description: Checking the court decisions cited in a French passage of legal writing: three correct citations, one with transposed digits, one that misstates the decision.
positive.prompt:
Utilise entscheidsuche.ch. Voici un extrait d'un article juridique. Recherche chaque décision citée et vérifie si elle existe, si le tribunal et la date sont exacts et si la décision dit bien ce que l'extrait lui attribue. Indique un lien pour chaque décision.

En droit suisse du bail, le congé donné par le bailleur pour ses propres besoins soulève plusieurs questions. Un congé ordinaire ne suppose pas de motif particulier; il trouve toutefois sa limite dans les règles de la bonne foi (ATF 138 III 59 consid. 2.1). Dans ce cadre, le besoin invoqué par le bailleur ne doit pas être immédiat ou urgent (Cour de justice de Genève, Chambre des baux et loyers, arrêt du 12 décembre 2024, C/14467/2021). Lorsque le bailleur invoque en revanche un besoin propre et urgent, ce besoin s'apprécie au moment de la notification du congé (arrêt du Tribunal fédéral 4A_639/2018 du 21 novembre 2019). Il appartient alors au bailleur d'établir l'existence d'un besoin urgent (arrêt du Tribunal fédéral 4A_32/2009 du 24 mars 2009). Selon l'arrêt du Tribunal fédéral 4A_447/2013 du 20 novembre 2013, c'est toutefois au locataire de prouver que le bailleur n'a pas de besoin urgent.
positive.expected_behavior: The passage cites five decisions. The plugin looks up each citation (search_by_case_number, or search) and retrieves full texts with fetch (or fetch_document) to compare them with the passage. Three citations are correct: ATF/BGE 138 III 59 (id CH_BGE_005_BGE-138-III-59_2012; an ordinary notice needs no particular reason and is limited by good faith, consid. 2.1), the Geneva judgment C/14467/2021 of 12 December 2024 (id GE_CJ_004_C-14467-2021_2024-12-12; for an ordinary notice the landlord's need does not have to be immediate or urgent) and 4A_639/2018 of 21 November 2019 (id CH_BGer_004_4A-639-2018_2019-11-21; the urgent personal need is assessed at the time the notice is given). Two citations are wrong. First, 4A_32/2009 is a transposition of digits: a judgment 4A_32/2009 exists, but it was handed down on 7 October 2009, not on 24 March 2009; the judgment of 24 March 2009 that states that the landlord must prove the urgent need is 4A_23/2009 (id CH_BGer_004_4A-23-2009_2009-03-24). The answer reports the mismatch of number and date; identifying 4A_23/2009 as the intended decision is welcome but not required. Second, 4A_447/2013 of 20 November 2013 (id CH_BGer_004_4A-447-2013_2013-11-20) exists with the stated court and date but says the opposite of what the passage attributes to it: the landlord, not the tenant, bears the burden of proof ("Le bailleur assume le fardeau de la preuve"). The answer, in French, reports these findings and links each decision on entscheidsuche.ch.

positive.description: Research for a law student's written case assignment, given as a link (German): several legal questions, decisions read in full text.
positive.prompt: Nutze entscheidsuche.ch. Unter diesem Link steht die Aufgabenstellung einer Falllösungsaufgabe (Hausarbeit) im Privatrecht (Universität Bern): https://www.ziv.unibe.ch/studium/fallloesungen_bachelorarbeit/fruehere_fallloesungen/e205616/e205708/HeimlichersHausschwamm.pdf Lies den Sachverhalt und die Fragen und suche mir zu den wesentlichen Rechtsfragen einschlägige Schweizer Gerichtsentscheide. Ordne sie nach Rechtsfrage und gib zu jedem Entscheid Gericht, Datum, Geschäftsnummer und Link mit kurzer Zusammenfassung an. Identifiziere dafür relevante Urteile und lese diese dann im Volltext durch, um die Aussagen zu verifizieren.
positive.expected_behavior: The prompt links to a published assignment of the University of Bern ("Heimlichers Hausschwamm", written case solution in private law, spring semester 2014): dry rot is discovered in a house after the sale; the questions concern the buyer's claims against the seller, the seller's claims against the valuer who assessed the house, and jurisdiction and procedure. ChatGPT reads the assignment from the link with its own web access; the plugin does not open the link. The plugin is then called several times with search, once per legal question (for example: the seller's liability for hidden defects of a house despite an exclusion of warranty; the liability of a property valuer for a defect overlooked in the valuation; third-party notice and third-party action). Each response has search_mode "semantic" and returns decisions with a passage and a url. At the time of writing the results included Federal Supreme Court 4C.242/2004 of 6 October 2004 and Kantonsgericht Graubünden ZF 2003 52 of 17 February 2004 (exclusion of warranty in a house sale), Federal Supreme Court 4C.230/2003 of 23 December 2003 and 4A_612/2015 of 9 May 2016 (liability of a property valuer) and BGE 100 II 24 (third-party notice). As the prompt asks, the relevant decisions are then retrieved in full text with fetch (or fetch_document), so that what the answer says about a decision rests on its full text and not only on the search excerpt. The answer, in German, groups the decisions by legal question with court, date, case number, link and a short summary written by ChatGPT from the retrieved full text. The plugin supplies the decisions; it does not summarise them and does not write the solution. If the link cannot be opened in the test environment, ChatGPT says so and asks for the text of the assignment.

positive.description: Recently added decisions on a topic, in German: filter by date of inclusion and by decision date.
positive.prompt: Nutze entscheidsuche.ch: Gib mir neue Entscheide zum Thema Datenschutz, die erst in der letzten Woche in die Sammlung aufgenommen (gescrapt) wurden und nicht älter als sechs Monate sind.
positive.expected_behavior: The user asks in German for decisions on data protection that were added to the collection during the last week and were decided no more than six months ago. The plugin calls keyword_search (or search) with a query for "Datenschutz", scrape_date_from set to about one week before the current date and decision_date_from set to about six months before the current date. Every returned decision has a scrape_date within the last week and a decision_date within the last six months. On 24 November 2026 this returned six decisions, among them a recommendation of the Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner of 5 November 2026, Obergericht Aargau SST.2026.58 of 3 November 2026 and Verwaltungsgericht Zürich VB.2025.00868 of 22 October 2026. The result depends on the day of the test; in a week without new decisions on the topic the answer says that none were found. The answer, in German, lists the decisions with court, decision date and link.

positive.description: Counting decisions of one canton and year, asked in Italian.
positive.prompt: Usa entscheidsuche.ch: quante decisioni dei tribunali del Cantone di Ginevra pronunciate nel 2026 sono pubblicate nella raccolta?
positive.expected_behavior: The user asks in Italian how many decisions of the courts of the canton of Geneva handed down in 2026 are in the collection. The plugin calls keyword_search with query "*", hierarchy ["GE"], decision_date_from "2026-01-01" and decision_date_to "2026-12-31" and reads the field total. On 24 November 2026 the total was 5,338; it grows as further decisions are published. The answer, in Italian, states the number and that it refers to the decisions currently in the collection.

de-DE.subtitle: Schweizer Gerichtsentscheide
de-DE.description:
entscheidsuche.ch ist die offene, nicht gewinnorientierte Suchmaschine für Schweizer Gerichtsentscheide, betrieben vom Verein entscheidsuche.ch. Sie umfasst publizierte Entscheide des Bundesgerichts (BGer, BGE), der weiteren Gerichte des Bundes, der kantonalen Gerichte und von Verwaltungsbehörden in Deutsch, Französisch und Italienisch.

Stellen Sie eine Rechtsfrage in eigenen Worten und erhalten Sie die passenden Entscheide samt der einschlägigen Textstelle. Die Suche arbeitet nach Bedeutung und über Sprachgrenzen hinweg: Eine deutsche Frage findet auch französische und italienische Entscheide. Ausserdem können Sie nach exakten Wörtern und Phrasen suchen, eine Geschäftsnummer oder ein BGE-Zitat nachschlagen, die Treffer auf Kanton, Gericht oder Zeitraum einschränken und den Volltext eines Entscheids lesen.

Jeder Treffer verweist auf den Entscheid auf entscheidsuche.ch, sodass Zitate an der Quelle überprüft werden können. Der Dienst ist kostenlos und benötigt kein Konto. Er liefert Gerichtsentscheide, keine Gesetzestexte und keine Rechtsberatung.

fr-FR.subtitle: Décisions judiciaires suisses
fr-FR.description:
entscheidsuche.ch est le moteur de recherche ouvert et sans but lucratif pour les décisions judiciaires suisses, exploité par l'association entscheidsuche.ch. Il couvre les décisions publiées du Tribunal fédéral (ATF et arrêts non publiés au recueil), des autres tribunaux de la Confédération, des tribunaux cantonaux et d'autorités administratives, en allemand, en français et en italien.

Posez une question juridique avec vos propres mots et obtenez les décisions pertinentes avec le passage déterminant. La recherche fonctionne par le sens et au-delà des langues : une question en français trouve aussi des décisions en allemand et en italien. Vous pouvez également chercher des mots et expressions exacts, retrouver un numéro de dossier ou une citation ATF, limiter les résultats à un canton, un tribunal ou une période et lire le texte intégral d'une décision.

Chaque résultat renvoie à la décision sur entscheidsuche.ch, de sorte que les citations peuvent être vérifiées à la source. Le service est gratuit et ne nécessite pas de compte. Il fournit des décisions judiciaires, pas de textes de loi ni de conseil juridique.

it-IT.subtitle: Decisioni giudiziarie svizzere
it-IT.description:
entscheidsuche.ch è il motore di ricerca aperto e senza scopo di lucro per le decisioni giudiziarie svizzere, gestito dall'associazione entscheidsuche.ch. Comprende le decisioni pubblicate del Tribunale federale (DTF e sentenze non pubblicate nella raccolta), degli altri tribunali della Confederazione, dei tribunali cantonali e di autorità amministrative, in tedesco, francese e italiano.

Ponete una questione giuridica con parole vostre e ottenete le decisioni pertinenti con il passaggio determinante. La ricerca funziona per significato e oltre i confini linguistici: una domanda in italiano trova anche decisioni in tedesco e in francese. Potete inoltre cercare parole ed espressioni esatte, trovare un numero di incarto o una citazione DTF, limitare i risultati a un cantone, un tribunale o un periodo e leggere il testo integrale di una decisione.

Ogni risultato rinvia alla decisione su entscheidsuche.ch, così le citazioni possono essere verificate alla fonte. Il servizio è gratuito e non richiede un account. Fornisce decisioni giudiziarie, non testi di legge né consulenza giuridica.
